description: This PHP class 'InstallerCompleteController' manages the behavior of the 'installation complete' screen in the OrangeHRM installer. It extends 'AbstractInstallerVueController' and primarily sets up the Vue component for the completion screen, configures state, and logs installation status during the pre-render step.

classes.name: InstallerCompleteController
classes.description: Controller for the 'installation complete' screen, responsible for setting up the Vue component, managing state, and logging during pre-render in the installer process.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the completion screen component, sets current screen state, clears state, and logs the installation status.
